modelReview.summary: The study is an unplanned exploratory Cox regression without testing the proportional hazards assumption, lacks essential reporting on cohort definition, variable coding, and missing data handling, and provides no reproducible materials. These issues must be resolved before the analysis can support any claims.

findings.title: Analysis is unbound and exploratory, not suitable for confirmatory claims
findings.whyItMatters: The analysis was not pre-registered, and the method was not chosen via a binding spec. P-values and confidence intervals from such an analysis are prone to overinterpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Either re-run with a pre-specified analysis plan or downgrade all claims to strictly hypothesis-generating, and remove significance language.

findings.title: Proportional hazards assumption not tested
findings.whyItMatters: Cox model coefficients are unreliable if the proportional hazards assumption is violated. No Schoenfeld residuals or other diagnostic test is reported.
findings.actionableFix: Perform Schoenfeld residuals test for each covariate and globally, and present results. If non-proportional, consider time-dependent covariates or stratified model.

findings.title: Cohort construction and missing data not reported
findings.whyItMatters: No inclusion/exclusion criteria, no flowchart, no handling of missing data other than complete-case N=240. Potential selection bias if missingness is not random.
findings.actionableFix: Provide a STROBE-style flowchart, describe missing data patterns, and consider sensitivity analysis or multiple imputation.

findings.title: Variable definitions, units, and coding absent
findings.whyItMatters: Interpretation of HRs requires knowing (e.g., treatment comparison groups, age scale, severity scoring). Lack of this makes results uninterpretable.
findings.actionableFix: Define each variable precisely, including reference categories for categorical variables and units for continuous ones.

findings.title: Analysis is not reproducible with provided artifacts
findings.whyItMatters: No raw data, analysis script, or container is provided. The hash inventory is insufficient for third-party reproduction of results.
findings.actionableFix: Include data (de-identified) and full analysis code in a runnable environment, or provide a Docker container with all dependencies.

findings.title: No model diagnostics for influence, outliers, or overall fit
findings.whyItMatters: Cox model may be sensitive to outliers or non-linear effects. Without checks (martingale residuals, dfbetas, C-index), the model may be misspecified.
findings.actionableFix: Calculate and report martingale residuals to assess functional form, dfbetas to check influence, and a concordance statistic.

findings.title: No literature context or comparison to prior findings
findings.whyItMatters: The paper lacks any references, which is needed to interpret the magnitude and direction of associations in context of existing evidence.
findings.actionableFix: Conduct a brief literature review and discuss how these results compare, especially for treatment and age effects.

findings.title: Hazard ratios reported without clinical interpretation
findings.whyItMatters: Although p-value caution is stated, the HRs themselves are not interpreted clinically (e.g., age HR=1.02 per year may be negligible).
findings.actionableFix: Add a discussion of the clinical or practical significance of each effect size.

missingEvidence: Raw data and analysis code absent
